app_fee.value: CAD 160 for applicants with international transcripts (CAD 112 with Canadian transcripts); non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: Application Fees are $112 for applicants with Canadian transcripts, $160 for applicants with international transcripts.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate Studies application pages do not mention an application-fee waiver.

gre_general.value: Graduate Studies sets no GRE rule; each program decides (see the program record).

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4.5 overall on the new 1-6 scale with at least 4.0 in each section; for tests taken before January 21, 2026, 90 overall with 20 in each section. Some programs ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: Internet-based TOEFL 4.5 or better overall, with a minimum of 4.0 in each section. | For tests taken prior to January 21, 2026: 90 with minimum of 20 in each category.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each section. Some programs ask for more.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (academic) overall band score of 6.5 of the academic (NOT general) test with a minimum of 6.0 in each section

english_waiver.value: The test is waived only for a degree taught in English in a country on SFU's list of English-primary countries; India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need a test score (the program's Graduate Program Assistant can be asked about exceptions).
english_waiver.quote: International applicants will not be required to complete an English-language test if they have completed a bachelor's degree or higher at an institution where the language of instruction and examination was in English in a country where English is the primary language. | Countries from which an English language proficiency test is not required | My previous education was in English but not in one of the countries above. Can I be exempt from the language requirements? | In this situation, you should contact the Graduate Program Assistant for the program to which you applied.

notes: Duolingo (125) and CAEL (70) are also accepted. All PhD programs fall under SFU's guaranteed minimum funding policy.
